native_install_mechanism: GEMINI.md context file loaded at session start

fallbacks.subagents: Sequential fresh-context review using the exact base..head package; report degraded independence.
fallbacks.browser_verification: Use command-line verification and record rendered-UI evidence as Not Run.

supported_runtime_versions: Gemini CLI with GEMINI.md hierarchical context support
install: Commit GEMINI.md at the repository root. Gemini CLI loads it as hierarchical context.
rollback: Restore the previous revision from version control.
limitations: No independent subagents and no native browser verification; activation is instructed rather than enforced.
deprecation: Designed adapter; runtime activation evidence is pending.
